items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And you know KIng Oliver was a great musician. He was one of the great firsts.

ctx.x: Well then it would a -- maybe a problem sometimes getting everybody to the job on time and getting everybody to the place on time --

Yeah, yeah. It was kind of rough that way, yeah. Wherein if you just stayed at a hotel -- but there was no hotels -- the hotels wouldn't take no colored in that town at that time you know. That'd be way before KIng.
